Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Acme Health's priorities around latency and secure on-prem inference. Quick recap from our side: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for pilot (up to 3 models) to replace current batch-only workflow and provide low-latency real-time inference for clinical search.
- Success criteria: P95 latency <= 200ms for search endpoints, integration with customer KMS, SOC2 evidence for audit.
- Next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive + hands-on demo for your engineering and security team to validate integration and performance.

Can you please confirm who from your side should join the deep dive (engineer(s), security/compliance, procurement if needed)? I propose the following times (all PDT):

- Wed, Mar 24 — 10:00–11:00am
- Wed, Mar 24 — 2:00–3:00pm

Thanks — looking forward to taking the next step.
